author: Patrikano
body:
Hello,

So today the walls tourney was on, and me and itimeless were in it. We won the first map pretty easily and then the second map came on. My teammate, Itimeless said something jokingly but zegita and _downcast took it as an insult and started to verbally attack us :/

I'm guessing you don't ban for verbal attack, but the least would be a warn?

Here's the evidence, btw just watch the start (first few mins) and the last few minutes, because the rest of it is just me playing the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BV-LbdkzLBo

P.s I didn't bother letting it process so sorry for bad quality...

P.P.s Seriously sorry for this quality, my potato camera does better quality
-Pat
